## Où j'en suis
Pg17 blue/green upgrade of the analytics RDS, staging first, plan only. The module now derives the parameter group family from the major version and exposes blue/green behind a flag; the AWS provider is pinned. Staging is set to 17.2 with blue/green = true (plan: 1 add, 1 change); prod is prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false` (plan: no changes). Draft PR #57 is open. Nothing applied.

- [en-cours] staging blue/green is planned but not applied
- [prochaine-étape] upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on 16.4 and check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` / `events_daily`, on staging before the switchover
- [prochaine-étape] pick the prod window: Saturday or Sunday 04:00–06:00 UTC suggested, once Maya signs off
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` failed on the locked aws 5.31.0; `init -upgrade` pulled aws v6, whose breaking changes gave 37 unrelated plan changes — reverted
- [décision] plan only, no apply (source: t01)
- [décision] pin aws 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade as a separate todo, nothing run against the db (source: t10)
- [décision] prod prepped but disabled; window must avoid the dbt lock 01:00–03:30 UTC (source: t12)
- [décision] no prod date until Maya's sign-off, apply_immediately stays false (source: t14)
- [décision] draft PR with the pg_partman step and the dbt lock in the description (source: t16)
